newsitem.title: JAPAN: Active sales hit IBJ, LTCB, NCB shares in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Active sales hit IBJ, LTCB, NCB shares in Tokyo.

text.p: Shares in the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ), the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) and Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) were hit by active sales on Wednesday morning, brokers said.
Sentiment for credit bank shares was hurt by a announcement by Moody"s Investors Service on Tuesday that it may downgrade the banks" senior debt ratings.
As of 0125 GMT, IBJ"s shares had fallen 40 yen to 1,380 yen, the lowest so far for this financial year.

LTCB"s shares dropped seven yen to 381 yen after falling as low as 373 yen, also a fresh low for this financial year. NCB"s shares slid nine yen to 219 yen in a turnover of 2.73 million, the fifth heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

It also said that reviews of the IBJ and LTCB ratings reflected its concern about the impact of Japan"s accelerating shift toward less regulated financial markets on these institutions" competitive positions as long-term credit banks.
Shortly after the Moody"s announcement, NCB and LTCB issued separate statements saying they regretted the rating agency"s move.
